title: graphty data member, version 1
description: The graph itself inside a graphty document (container.md, 'The data member'): either embedded as one of graph-io's JSON dialects, or a reference to a file in any format graphty-element reads. Normative for what a writer produces. Its members are closed: a reader skips a data member with a member this schema does not list.

format.description: A format id from graphty-element's format catalogue: json, csv, graphml, gexf, gml, dot, pajek, or one a plugin registered. Embedded data is always json.

dialect.description: The graph-io JSON dialect of embedded data: node-link, d3, jgf, cytoscape, graphology, vis, or one a later graph-io adds. Required with graph. A reader whose graph-io does not read it skips the member with E_UNKNOWN_FORMAT.

graph.description: The graph, embedded as a JSON value in the named dialect, written with that dialect's own member names.

href.description: Where the data file is: a path relative to the document, or an https: URL with no user name or password. Checked after resolution and never fetched without the caller's consent (container.md, 'The data member').

options.description: Import options of a referenced file, by the names graphty-element's format catalogue declares for the named format (container.md, 'Import options'). The list is open and checked against the reading release's catalogue: in version 1, edgeSource, edgeTarget, directed and repeatedEdges for every format, delimiter, variant and idColumn for CSV, nodeIdPath for JSON. The keys graphty-element keeps for its own use (url, data, file, ...) are never import options of a document. Column and field names are plain names, never evaluated.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the referenced file's bytes, lower-case hex.

then.description: Embedded data: graph and dialect, format json, and none of the members of a reference.

else.description: Referenced data: href, and no dialect.
